main_text.head: Particularis Græciæ descriptio.
Bæotia Thessaliam proximè excipit.
main_text.p: stat.Theb. lib.7.Ocalæa opp. Medon opp. Nisa. Thisbe opp.Jungunt se castris, regisq; in nomen adoptant Ocalea, Medeonque, & confertissima syluis Nifa, Dionæisque auibus circunsona Thisbe. Proximus Eurymedon, cui pastoralia Fauni Arma patris, pinusque inbas imitatur equinas: Terribilis syluis, reor, & Mauorte cruento

Erythræ vrbs. Scolon. Eteone. Hyle. Schœ- nos.Talis erit: dites pecorum comitantur Erythræ, Qui Scolon, densámque iugis Eteonon tnquis, Qui breue littus Hyles, Atalantaúmque superbi Schœnon habent, notique colunt vestigia campi. Fraxineas vibrant Macedum de more sarrissas, Sauáque d ficiles excludere vulnera Peltæ.
Ecce autem clamore ruunt Neptunia plebes

Onchestis. Mycalessus. Melos fl. Gargaphye. Haliartos.Onchesti quos Pinigeris Mycalessius in agris, Palladiúsque Melas, hecataáque gurgite nutrit Gargaphye, quorum que nouis Haliartos aristis Inuidet, & nimiá sata lata superuenit herba. Tela rudes trunci galea vacua ora Leonum.

Et paulo post. Helicon. Permessus fons. Omius fl.Vos etiam nostris Heliconia turba venitis Addere opem, túque ô Permesse canoris, Et felix Omie vadis, armatis alumnos Bellorum resi es: patriis concentibus audis Exultare gregem: quales, cum pallida cedit Bruma, renidentem deducunt Strimona cygni.

Et paulo post. Ithone. Alalcmon fl. Midea opp. Arne oppid. Græa oppid. Platea opp. Pereon. Eu- rippus.Ite alacres, nunquam vestri morientur honores, Bellaque perpetuo memorabunt carmine Musa. Ducit Ithonæos, & Alalcomenæa Minerua Agmina, quas Midee, quos humida suggerit Arne. Aulida, qui Graám que serunt, viridésque Platéas, Et sulco Pereóna domant, refluúmque meatu Euripum, qua noster alit, teque vltima trastu

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are set in small type and are reproduced as printed. Catchword-like mark "Anthe" at the foot right is probably the start of the next word. Some letters are doubtful due to scan quality, notably in "Ocalæa", "Eteone", and the ends of lines in the verse.
